prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: right-side hero photograph for the Stamer Cello hotels and estates service page
Scene and subject: An unoccupied boutique hotel lounge in the Cape Winelands before an evening set. A real-looking full-size amber-brown acoustic cello stands upright in a discreet black floor stand beside a single olive upholstered chair. Tall dark timber French doors frame a leafy estate garden and the soft late-afternoon light. Cream plaster, a dark timber floor and gentle patina give the room the quiet character of a small independent estate.
Style: restrained editorial hospitality photography, natural window light, believable wood and linen texture, balanced exposure, rich but muted olive, cream and warm timber. One recognisable instrument with four strings, a correctly placed bridge, two f-holes and plausible proportions.
Composition: portrait 4:5, camera across the room at eye level, cello and chair near the centre with generous margin. Keep the whole cello legible within the central horizontal strip for a 4:3 mobile crop. Give the architecture room to read. No typography overlay is needed.
Constraints: fictional unbranded property, no people, no signage, no logos, no text, no watermark.
